title: Information Technology, B.S. -- Application Development Option (University College, Brandywine)
notes: REBUILT 2026-09-18 by QA reviewer #3. This bulletin page is NOT campus-specific -- it concatenates 44 separate Suggested-Academic-Plan tables (one per campus x option combination: Beaver, Brandywine, DuBois, Greater Allegheny, Hazleton, Lehigh Valley, Mont Alto, New Kensington, Schuylkill, Scranton, Shenango, Wilkes-Barre, York, each offering a different subset of the Application Development / Business Applications / Cybersecurity / Security and Risk Analysis / Specialized Technology options). bulletin_scraper.py's parse_suggested_plan() only ever returns ONE table (the first one on the page, or the MDE table if present) -- for this page that is Beaver Campus's Application Development table, NOT Brandywine's. The prior version of this file was built from that wrong, non-Brandywine table (its item placement didn't match Brandywine's real plan at all: it moved the STAT 200/SCM 200/DS 200 requirement out of Year 2 Fall and mislabeled a different slot 'Business Selection (ACCTG 211)' there instead, and it dropped IST 261 entirely from Year 2 Fall). This rebuild instead isolates the real 'Application Development Option: Information Technology, B.S. at Brandywine Campus' section of the page's own HTML (matching this file's own campus:["Brandywine"] field) before running parse_suggested_plan() on it, for 2026 specifically via archive_url_for_year. Every course item's options are that isolated table's own linked_codes; every slot matches its own is_generic_slot=true; every semester's item-credit sum matches that isolated table's own subtotal_credits (123 total, matching its own printed 'Total Credits 120' -- 2026 predates the SRA 221->CYBER 221 / IST 302-311-331-411-412->ETI/HCDD renaming that first appears in the 2025-26 edition, confirmed by comparing this year's isolated table against 2025/2026's). Source: https://bulletins.psu.edu/undergraduate/colleges/university-college/information-technology-bs/
